description: EPA AQS monitor metadata for an area — which pollutants are measured where, by which agency, with what method and network membership (NCore, PAMS, SLAMS), the monitoring objective, and each monitor's open and close dates. Use it to find the site codes aqs_sample_data needs and to check whether a place is monitored at all. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

edate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD — same calendar year as bdate

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

limit.description: Max monitor rows to return (default 200, max 2000)

param.description: Pollutant parameter code(s), comma-separated, max 5, e.g. "44201"

name: aqs_monitors
title: Aqs Monitors
